Enterprise Business Solutions

Comprehensive Business Management Features

POSBOK provides a suite of integrated tools designed to streamline Mobile Money Operation, Sales, Inventory, Warehousing, and E-commerce, helping businesses operate efficiently from a single platform.

Mobile Money Operation Management

(POS agent bookkeeping)

Record Withdrawals, Deposit and Transfer with 100% Calculation and Analysis Report

For: Mobile Money operator, POS agent

Inventory Management

Record & Track Sales in real time, Manage Stock levels, Multi-shop sales, stock taking, and print receipt wirelessly.

For: Supermarkets, Pharmacies, Boutiques, Grocery, Bookstores, Warehouses and all types of retailers and wholesalers.

Warehouse Management

(Parking House)

Take records of goods as they arrive in bulk into your warehouse or parking house, and easily move to your different shop inventory while you assign staff to carry them.

For: Supermarkets, Pharmacies, Boutiques, Grocery Stores, Bookstores, Warehouses and all types of retailers and wholesalers who own a warehouse or parking house.

E-commerce

Deploy an E-commerce site for your shop easily with the same inventory items for both online and physical stores linked together.
